profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Amazon
profile.summary: Experienced software developer with a demonstrated history of taking on new projects that span a multitude of applications and languages.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer in Amazon's Grocery Tech division, I build the core platform that powers strategic assortment decisions for Amazon Fresh, Whole Foods, and Amazon Go. We empower category managers to curate the perfect product mix for every store by translating complex data science recommendations and supply chain guardrails into actionable insights.

Currently, I am a key developer on a next-generation, AI-powered platform that unifies our core grocery management systems into a single, intelligent experience. This initiative provides our users with unprecedented control and insight through a more dynamic and intuitive interface, fundamentally reshaping their roles and defining the future of retail technology at Amazon.

positions.title: Software Developer & Integrator III
positions.description: Develop an end to end experience for the business through a host of RESTful APIs as well as a web based front end written in React.

positions.title: MLSC Tutor
positions.description: Supplementing students with new ways of thinking about the difficult topics they learn in class, in the areas of College Algebra all the way to Calculus 3.

projects.title: Yournal
projects.description:
Yournal is meant to be as simple of an experience as possible to get started recording your daily memories. While I am still in development on this, Yournal already provides the following:
* Local Artificial Emotional Intelligence to analyze your sentiment in real time
* Curated lists to highlight your top memories over the years
* Pre-loaded and customizable prompts
* Streaks!!!
* Tons of color options
* Completely free of charge

This project was written completely in SwiftUI with MVVM architecture. It utilizes CoreData for its database, and CloudKit for cross-device consistency (cloud storage). It uses RevenueCat APIs to support In-App-Purchases for tips.
